newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips $2 with weaker crude, U.S level.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips $2 with weaker crude, U.S level.

text.p: NWE gasoline tracked southwards on Wednesday as a combination of bearish factors exerted pressure.
Eurograde cargoes were around $214 cif NWE, off $2 a tonne.
Weaker crude and NYMEX gasoline helped slam shut the arbitrage window to the U.S., forcing European cargoes to try and find European homes. But there was little buying evident.
"People stand back from a falling market," said one trader.
Swaps talk was equally sparse. By late afternoon Jan swaps were down $2 to $213 fob ARA.
"I haven't seen any physical cargoes and there's not much going on in swaps," said one trader.
